model_choice: Position encoding (N^2 binary variables). Each variable x[i,t] indicates station i is visited at position t. The one-hot constraints on rows (each station once) and columns (each position once) enforce a permutation matrix. Since the objective sums costs over adjacent positions t and t+1 (modulo N), the permutation is forced to be a single cycle of length N, yielding an exact TSP formulation without subtour elimination constraints. For N=60, variables=3600, fitting the CGA backend limit of ~3600 variables.
